author: codepawl
description:
SimReady GLB
	



Open the 3D viewer to search all 2,595 models and
orbit any of them in the browser.
Web-ready glTF binary (.glb) copies of the 3D models in
nvidia/simready-assets. Each file loads directly in
three.js, Babylon.js, model-viewer or any glTF 2.0 viewer.
Models by NVIDIA SimReady, licensed CC BY 4.0. This dataset converts and compresses them. It does not change what
they show. If you use these files, credit NVIDIA as the original author and link the source dataset.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/codepawl/simready-glb.
